tool.name: Get View Catalog
tool.description: Get the catalog of USE components, props, and actions available for building generative views.

filter.description: Optional substring to filter component names (e.g. 'stack')

ai.systemPromptSection:
### get_view_catalog
Get the reference of valid USE components, props, and actions before authoring a view document.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"get_view_catalog","query":"{}"}
```

**Returns:** Compact JSON listing every component type (with props and whether it accepts children/actions), all action types, and the spec shape.
whenToUse: Before calling create_view or update_view for the first time in a conversation
When unsure whether a component type or prop exists
whenNotToUse: The catalog was already fetched earlier in this conversation

sovereignty.approvalDescription: Read the generative view component catalog
